title: World History Milestones
description: Travel through empires, revolutions, peace treaties, and world-shaping events from ancient times to modern history.
seoTitle: World History Milestones Quiz – Empires & Revolutions | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: 10 questions on major world history events: the Roman Empire, French Revolution, World War I, and ancient civilizations.

questions.question: In what year did Christopher Columbus first make landfall in the Americas?
questions.explanation: Christopher Columbus anchored at an island in the Bahamas (Guanahani) on October 12, 1492.

questions.question: Who was the first Emperor of the Roman Empire, reigning from 27 BC until AD 14?
questions.explanation: Augustus (originally Gaius Octavius) became the first Roman Emperor after the demise of the Roman Republic.

questions.question: The storming of which prison fortress in Paris on July 14, 1789, ignited the French Revolution?
questions.explanation: The Storming of the Bastille on July 14, 1789, represented an assault on royal tyranny and is commemorated as Bastille Day.

questions.question: In which city did the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand take place in 1914, triggering World War I?
questions.explanation: Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria was assassinated in Sarajevo on June 28, 1914, sparking the July Crisis and World War I.

questions.question: Which historic wall dividing a European city fell on November 9, 1989?
questions.explanation: The fall of the Berlin Wall in November 1989 marked the beginning of the end of the Cold War and led to German reunification.

questions.question: Which English monarch signed the Magna Carta at Runnymede in the year 1215?
questions.explanation: King John granted the Magna Carta under pressure from rebel barons in June 1215, establishing that the sovereign is subject to law.

questions.question: Which ancient civilization created the monumental Step Pyramid of Djoser?
questions.explanation: The Step Pyramid of Djoser at Saqqara was built during the Third Dynasty of ancient Egypt by the architect Imhotep.

questions.question: What devastating pandemic swept across Eurasia and North Africa between 1346 and 1353?
questions.explanation: The Black Death was caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis, resulting in the deaths of an estimated 75-200 million people.

questions.question: Which military leader conquered the Persian Empire and established an empire stretching from Greece to northwest India before age 30?
questions.explanation: Alexander III of Macedon (Alexander the Great) created one of the largest empires of the ancient world by 323 BC.

questions.question: What landmark international organization was created in 1945 immediately following the conclusion of World War II?
questions.explanation: The United Nations was officially established on October 24, 1945, after the Charter was ratified by 51 founding countries.
